capabilities: Auto-sync notes to Mengram on save with debounce
Search synced memories from the command palette
Bulk-sync the current file or entire vault
extras: Freemium: free tier limited to 100 adds and 500 searches per month, paid plans available. Sends note content to mengram.io over HTTPS; no data leaves the vault without an API key. Supports self-hosted instances via a base URL setting. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author states the vault already holds what you know and wanted to make it something AI assistants can actually read.
problem: Obsidian notes stay locked in the vault, so AI assistants like Claude or Cursor cannot answer questions from what you have written.

requires.name: Mengram paid plan beyond free tier limits

summary: Syncs vault notes to the Mengram service, extracting entities, facts and relationships into searchable memory for AI assistants via MCP.
